_comment: Update weekly specials. weekOf should be the Monday of the current week.

items.name: Colcannon Soup
items.label: Soup of the Day
items.description: A creamy Irish classic inspired by traditional colcannon - potatoes, cabbage, and onion simmered in broth and finished with milk and butter.

items.name: Winter Orchard Salad
items.label: Seasonal Salad
items.description: Mixed greens with feta crumbles, dried cranberries, toasted pecans, and shaved red onion with a white balsamic vinaigrette.

items.name: Mockingbird Reuben Pressed
items.label: Featured Pressed Sandwich
items.description: Corned beef, sauerkraut, Swiss cheese, and Russian dressing pressed until crisp and melty.
notes: Served with pickled and Featured Side

items.name: Roasted Dijon Potatoes
items.label: Featured Side
items.description: Roasted potatoes tossed with olive oil, Dijon mustard, garlic, and herbs.

items.name: Irish Cream Cheesecake
items.label: Sweet Bite of the Day
items.description: Rich and creamy cheesecake with a hint of Irish cream liqueur on a chocolate cookie crust.
